searchText: Why do we need `blobs` here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/431cf72fd3403d946ca3e3afc36b973fc87e0e89/src/schemas/transaction.yaml#L414 ? Looks to have been added in https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/477 but I don't actually see if being consumed anywhere in there. It does seem somewhat out of place to be a field in `GenericTransaction` eventually we'll get around to update eth_fillTransaction so that it will calc the blob hashes for the tx the idea being, every eth lib shouldn't need to also have kzg libraries What I find surprising w/ it being in `GenericTransaction` is that that schema is the input for `eth_call` and friends, are we expecting all of these RPCs to accept `blobs` params? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/eth/execute.yaml. Perhaps `eth_fillTransaction` should have its own schema object when its added?
